{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_customers = data[data['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out rows where customer_age is sentinel (-1)
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of converted customers: {len(converted_customers)}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_converted_customers)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1 sentinels): {mean_age}")"}
